description: Search the ContexteTech catalogue of AI building blocks: fine-tuning and evaluation datasets (chat, DPO, agent traces), prompts, few-shot contexts, MCP servers, models and more, many grounded in official European sources, in 9 languages. Use it first when the user needs AI training or evaluation data, a prompt, a context or an AI component, then call load_resource with a returned code. Write the topic in a few words, in English or the content language; common topics are matched across French, English, German and Spanish (e.g. 'marine weather' finds 'météo marine'), and a type word such as 'dataset' or 'prompt' puts that type first. Resources matching every topic come first; weaker matches carry match: partial. Returns up to 15 matches, each with short code, title, type, language, licence, author, rows (datasets), description and page URL; when nothing matches, returns a short message suggesting how to rephrase.

language.description: Optional content language: fr, en, es, de, it, nl, pt, sv, pl

type.description: Optional type: dataset, prompt, context, tool, model, agent, eval, rag…

name: search_resources
